label: bitFlyer Lightning
terms_note: Public HTTP API only (no key). Docs in Japanese (lightning.bitflyer.com/docs?lang=ja, also English), HTML only. The docs limit the HTTP API to 500 requests per 5 minutes per IP. No OHLC endpoint in the public HTTP API. Live 2026-10-01: an unknown product answers 400 {"status":-100,"error_message":"Invalid product"}; product codes are matched case-insensitively (btc_jpy works) but answered upper-case.

list_markets.note: Every product (BTC_JPY, ETH_BTC, FX_BTC_JPY ...) with its market type (Spot, FX, Futures).

get_ticker.note: volume is the 24h volume of this product (volume_by_product); `volume` in raw is the total across products.

not_offered.me: Private API calls need ACCESS-KEY and an HMAC-SHA256 ACCESS-SIGN; public-data entry only.
not_offered.get_candles: The public HTTP API has no OHLC endpoint (only executions and the board); not mapped.
not_offered.get_balances: GET /v1/me/getbalance needs an API key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.list_orders: GET /v1/me/getchildorders needs an API key; public-data entry only.
not_offered.place_order: POST /v1/me/sendchildorder needs an API key and spends money; not mapped.
not_offered.cancel_order: POST /v1/me/cancelchildorder needs an API key; not mapped.

live_check.notes: all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
